parse_html_string: parse an HTML string into a selectolax parse tree for querying elements
extract_elements_from_html: extract specific elements from an HTML string using selectolax CSS selectors
build_html_parser: build a selectolax HTML parser tree from a raw HTML string input
review_html_structure: review the structure of an HTML document by parsing it into a selectolax tree
summarize_html_content: summarize the content of an HTML page by parsing it with selectolax and inspecting nodes
